metadata.title: January 6, 2012 - Chill Out
metadata.author: by Dan Fisher / Edited by Mike Shenk

entries.clue: They turn a blind eye to others
Nation with a tree on its flag
Bonsai trees cut down for wood?
"Charlotte's Web" pig no longer confined to a pen?
Musical set on a Greek island
Giving Justin a breather by taking the stage for him?
Put to sleep, so to speak
Church work by a woman who's not ordained?
Goddess whose temple was lighted every night
Proud parent's comment when Junior calculates 2 x 2 x 2?
Cop's disappointed cry on reading a breathalyzer?
Roman river after a big ink spill?
Chilly comment added phonetically to phrases in this puzzle
Fan fiction based on "Cimarron" and "Show Boat"?
